title: Guess Number Higher or Lower II
goal: Solve Guess Number Higher or Lower II: For each interval, choose a guess minimizing its price plus the more expensive of the two remaining subintervals.
strategy: For each interval, choose a guess minimizing its price plus the more expensive of the two remaining subintervals.
edgeCases: A one-number interval costs zero; minimizing average cost would not satisfy the worst-case guarantee.
inputRules: n must be a positive integer
keep n at 9 or below so the DP table stays readable
